meta.title: Entanglement entropy of the dimerized chain

panels.title: Entropy of the first l spins, N=12

0.text: J2=0. The chain is a product of singlets. A cut through a dimer gives exactly log 2, and a cut between dimers gives zero.

panels.title: Entropy of the first l spins, N=12

1.text: J2=0.1. The cut through a dimer gives 1.00 log 2, and the cut between dimers gives 0.01 log 2. The weak bond J2 entangles neighboring dimers a little, so the cut between dimers is small but no longer zero.

10.text: J2=1. This is the uniform Heisenberg chain, which is critical. The entropy is of order log 2 for every cut, with an even-odd alternation that comes from the open ends. With 12 spins we cannot resolve the slow growth with the size of A.

panels.title: Entropy of the first l spins, N=12

11.text: J2=1.1. The bonds J2 are now the strong ones, so the dimers are formed between sites 2 and 3, 4 and 5, and so on. The cuts through a J2 bond have the largest entropy, up to 1.13 log 2.
